content.comment_body: Hello, I am using the [product_name] and tried building my first project. I noticed there's no option to display decimal points for analog values. After checking this forum, I found that people suggest modifying the HTML JavaScript like this: • var value = getValueByBlockFormat(blockFormat, accessModeType, this.m_sValue)/10; • actVal = (value/10).toFixed(1); However, this change affects all analog values, not just specific ones. Is it possible to apply this change only to selected values? Thank you in advance.

I don't think it's possible to change only certain values with a single entry at the specified place in the code. There's a link in a German forum, last post on 18.11.2019, and also a PDF document with comments in German.

Thanks for your response. I translated the German text and it seems the proposed method should be used only for values that cannot be directly modified. In my situation, I handle AM1 (analog flag) and NI (network input). Has anyone else experienced this issue?

So far, I haven't used custom web pages at home or at work, so I have only looked for simple solutions to adjust displayed values, such as showing a temperature like 23.5°C. Hopefully, this helps others reading here. If someone is skilled with HTML5, they can do much more. See the provided link for details about [product_name] in chapter 4, which describes the HTML interface and includes a callback function for updating editable values.

I am attaching an example with two variables, 1st and 2nd. When I change only the 1st variable from main.htm, the decimal does not appear. But when I modify the 2nd variable, both variables show a decimal point. Is this expected? (The JavaScript change used is: var actVal = (value / 10).toFixed(1);)

analysis.insight_summary: A user found that displaying decimal points on individual analog values within [product_name] was not straightforward. Modifying the script led to all analog values displaying with decimal formatting, not just targeted variables. There is uncertainty over how to selectively apply value formatting, highlighting the limited flexibility and lack of clear documentation in the tool.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to selectively format decimal points for certain analog variables within [product_name], rather than having formatting changes affect all variables globally.
